Quality and Efficiency of Implementation.source_section: Section 3 — Quality and Efficiency of Implementation

compliance_checklist.description: Proposal must be submitted by the deadline and comply with page limits and formatting requirements as specified in the call conditions.
Consortium must meet minimum participant requirements: at least three independent legal entities established in three different EU Member States or Associated Countries.
Each participant must be a legal entity (public or private body, including international organisations) and must not be subject to exclusion criteria under the Financial Regulation.
The proposal must fall within the scope of the call topic HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02 and address the stated expected outcomes and impacts.
Mandatory cohesion activities with ADRA and GenAI4EU Hub must be included as required by the call's procedure_exceptions field.
